Game edits are derived from hueponik's WipEout 3 Special Edition patches:
https://codeberg.org/hueponik/wip3out-patches

The NTSC x2 / 120 Hz package keeps hueponik's every-vblank unlock, retargets 60 Hz timing scales to 120 Hz, and relies on psxrecomp's CRTC refresh multiplier (NTSC x2) plus 120 Hz host pacing.
Mutually exclusive with `wipeout3.enhancement.framerate`.
